patient_identity.statement: III:1 is the index male, son of II:4. Figure1A and the opening Results identify all four affected males consistently.
limitations: One prose sentence mislabels brotherII:2 and unclesI:3/I:4; pedigree establishes brotherIII:2 and unclesII:1/II:2.
Index age6atstudy versus MRI9.5years chronology is not explained; uncles ages44/46 not independently mapped.

genotype.statement: Hemizygous CSTF2c.149A>C/p.Asp50Ala reported and Sanger cosegregation described in affected males.
limitations: Source uses NM_001306206.1 and chrX:100077251A>C explicitly labeledGRCh38.p12; packet uses NM_001325.3 and GRCh38chrX100822262A>C. Coding/protein correspondence supported; exact coordinate/transcript equivalence not independently normalized.

segregation.statement: Four affected males II:1,II:2,III:1,III:2 carry the allele. II:4 is Mut/WT in the tested pedigree; maternal-line inheritance is reported.
limitations: I:2 is shown as a carrier by pedigree but lacks the explicit tested Mut/WT label used for II:4. Uncles children are described unaffected without displayed genotypes. Three other X-linked candidate variants also cosegregate.

phase.statement: Single hemizygous X allele; compound-heterozygous phase is not applicable. Maternal transmission fits the pedigree.
limitations: No de-novo claim; grandmother carrier state is not directly shown by a sequence result.

causal_confidence.statement: One family cosegregation plus exact D50A reporter, RRM binding/structural and mouse-brain RNA effects supports relevance to familial intellectual disability.
limitations: Single pedigree; no demonstrated human-brain defect or mouse cognitive phenotype/rescue. X-exome and selected tests do not exclude all genetic alternatives. COL4A5P739H is deprioritized using control observations for a different P739A allele, not definitive benign proof.

Molecular RNA affinity increases while reporter polyadenylation decreases; these distinct effects should not be collapsed into simple loss of RNA binding. Bulk S2/S3/S5 tables remain partially unread.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All assigned phenotype assertions compared individually. Speech delay, normal motor milestones and mild ID are described, but quantitative cognitive scores and detailed developmental ages are absent.
limitations: Reported clinical scope is limited; lack of other consistent phenotype does not establish each specific negative.
MRIhypersignal follows intracranial hypertension, not established primary CSTF2 pathology; no MRIimage supplied.

assessment.statement: c.149A>C/p.Asp50Ala and hemizygosity match the source allele and Figure1.
limitations: Printed source genomic coordinate and transcript differ from packet; no exact genomic normalization claimed.

assessment.statement: Index speech retarded, developmental delay recognized in early childhood/first school years, with additional speech therapy; childhood onset supported.
Index motor milestones including walking were explicitly within normal limits.
Results heading explicitly describes mild intellectual disability in males of FamilyP167; index has low verbal/nonverbal EDEI performance and special schooling.
limitations: No individual numerical IQ/adaptive-function score or detailed severity assessment supplied.
Pedigree resolves source numbering inconsistencies; source coordinates remain unresolved.

Main671lines/18pages and all six figures fully read. All three assigned packets and seven phenotype assertions adjudicated; unassigned brotherIII:2 and all alternative variants considered.

Supplement figuresS1–S6, all legends, TableS1 and every TableS4cell fully read. TableS2only Legend1–15,DGEAll1–2,Diff1–15 read; DGEAll3–25816unread. S3only1–2of7952read; S5only1–2of6149read. All pixels for these three bulk workbooks remain unread. Overall review incomplete.

Source pedigree/prose numbering and index age6versus MRI9.5discrepancies retained; no cross-relative negative transfer. SourceGRCh38coordinate100077251 differs from packet100822262; exact normalization unresolved.

All four X-linked variants cosegregate. STARD8control prevalence and ALG13control/predictor evidence are historical source observations. Different COL4A5P739A control observations do not prove P739H benign. No current database assertion or genome-wide exclusion.

D50A reporter reduced, RNAaffinity increased, CSTF3coexpression restores reporter/localization. Isolated RRM/heterologous cells/mouse brains support mechanism, not clinical causality proof. No neurobehavioral assay demonstrated here.

Mouse methods/Figure6caption state3WT5mut; S1caption and S1E/S5/Figure6tracks display3WT4mut. S2headers contain5mut3WT; S3/S5headers also8samples including01notshown in S5. Omission reason unresolved, not an invented exclusion.

Figure6Jcounts conflict with TableS4CDSShort: figure top-to-bottom43,43,32,42,39,50,58,57,17,22 whereas corresponding workbook rows22,17,57,58,50,39,42,32,43,43. The ten count labels appear reversed; significance bars/GO identities not independently recomputed. Figure6Gcount labels match the corresponding S4rows after tie reordering.

TableS4CDSLong top FDR0.0563 and all other displayed values>0.05 support no enriched GO at0.05, despite low raw P values. Source reference to TableS3forGO is misdirected; GO tables are S4. Raw FisherP<0.05APA calls are distinct from FDR-adjustedGO and DGE.

1370equals571+290+396+113category totals; independence/unique-gene deduplication cannot be verified with unread bulk tables. Shorter transcript does not itself demonstrate lower function. Whole-brain cell-composition effects not excluded.

Figure1site-IIlabelN19 conflicts with Phe19inmain/Figure4; TableS1caption points TITAN to S4although line-shape plots are S3. S4legend promises R-squared but figure displays RMSDonly. S1restriction schematic labels697bp versus515+179; retain printed values without redesign or independent assay reconstruction.

ITCKdapproximately0.7vs1.52supports~2foldaffinity; NMR0.54vs0.70andFP0.93vs1.45do not support universal less-than-halfKd wording. Similar off-rates support faster association; prolonged occupancy/specifically reduced binding specificity are hypotheses, not directly measured consequences.

S2reported log2foldchanges are not simple logarithms of displayed adjusted-count ratios; statistical estimation details insufficient to reconstruct here. All14significant rows read; no recomputation or bulk-read claim.

Methods/supplementary sequences read for source appraisal only; no wet-labdesign/execution, native/browserUI, contacts or externalpublication. Prior exposure conservativelyper_case; predecessor reviews retain attribution.
